training_margin_diagnostic.interpretation: The tenfold scalar changed the selected solution and improved the held development gate, but did not reduce the observed batch-level core hinge violation. Blindly scaling the same aggregate term again is therefore not the next identified intervention.

compute.metering_note: Usage is reported once over the complete H0-013 interval at Colab's visible precision; the identical interval embedded in pilot and screen summaries must not be summed.

administrative_note.event: The Colab UI briefly reported an inactivity disconnect during the screen.
administrative_note.resolution: Reconnection attached to the same live backend; the uninterrupted process resumed reporting at step 72 and completed all 128 updates.

interpretation.supported: At fixed trajectory evolution and negative coverage, stronger aggregate margin pressure directionally improves the learned identity geometry on the paired development seed.
interpretation.not_supported: The intervention did not yield Holm-robust core separation and does not justify multi-seed replication, functional confirmation, or PROTO-015.
interpretation.mechanistic_update: The remaining uncertainty is no longer whether trajectory evolution or negative coverage matter. It is whether the core-margin gradient is too small, conflicts with reconstruction/NCE gradients, or is trained against the wrong hard-negative geometry.
interpretation.next_test: Run a development-only gradient-geometry evaluation on frozen H0-011 and H0-013 checkpoints before choosing another training intervention.
